serialization: One Document: prefix per block, EOS per chunk, two newlines between chunks; blocks stop at numbered section/chapter changes. Source chunks are contiguous, nonoverlapping, paragraph preferred, tokenizer offsets split oversized paragraphs.
gate: Unchanged: controls 2/2, finite normalized 768D, 8192 float32 fit, GPU cleanup, validation macro page precision AND recall >= matched independent chunks. No selection or tuning on validation scores.
limitations: Agent labels, small single-book validation; no claim-level quality or generalization acceptance.
